registration_contract.worlds: At least two unique positive integer seed objects. Optional demand/penetration metadata must be present on every world if used.

planner.decision_interval_s: Optional; default 60. Positive integer divisor of 1200, preserved when explicitly supplied.

optional_planner_keys.k_candidates: Positive integer; quoted rollouts also include the none comparator

registration_contract.optional_calibration: Path plus lowercase 64-character sha256, reference only; never opened here
registration_contract.seed_source: Only the registration file explicitly passed by the caller

analysis_contract.contrast: PLANNER minus MAPPO; negative means improved delay
analysis_contract.bootstrap: 10000 paired whole-world resamples, numpy default_rng(20261101), percentile 95% CI and two-sided CI-inversion p
analysis_contract.completeness: Every registered world x arm exactly once, with signed receipts bound to generated jobs
analysis_contract.safety_gate: Per world: collisions/teleports must not increase; hard_brake plus ttc_below_1p5_events must not increase. Descriptive paired CIs for every counter.
analysis_contract.hash_interoperability: Canonical SHA-256 sealing interoperates with exact_grade.verify_sealed
